mentions.name: PDL
mentions.description: A custom DSL, one of a pair of data transformation and chart visualization DSLs designed to pair well together. It ships a full LSP built into the binaries that compiles to CLI and WASM, and provides native GIS support with GeoJSON and Shapefile.
